title: Add A/B experiment quality delta reporter + Console summary artifacts (v1)
author: Olivia Grant
pr_body: Context: As part of route-level A/B testing in Console, we need a stable artifact that summarizes offline quality deltas between experiment variants for a given eval suite/prompt set. This PR introduces a new reporter that takes existing eval run outputs (per-prompt scores) for each variant, computes aggregate metrics + deltas vs a selected control variant, and exports versioned summary artifacts consumed by Console. Primary use case: Console “Results” tab can show quality deltas side-by-side with latency/cost/error metrics without requiring Console to understand raw eval traces. What’s included: (1) New reporter `AbExperimentQualityDeltaReporter` that groups eval results by {experiment_id, eval_suite_id, variant_id} and computes mean metrics and delta-to-control for supported metric types. (2) Artifact schemas v1 written via the existing artifact store: `ab_experiment_quality_summary_v1.json` (rollup) and `ab_experiment_quality_details_v1.jsonl` (optional per-metric breakdown suitable for drilldowns). (3) Stats: bootstrap percentile CI for delta-of-means (default 2,000 resamples), two-sided p-values (bootstrap-based), and Holm–Bonferroni correction applied per suite across reported metrics. (4) Guardrails: emits warnings + `insufficient_sample` flags when N < min_samples (default 200 prompts) and always includes the effective sample sizes used per metric (to account for missing/invalid scores). (5) Determinism + reproducibility: reporter takes `--seed` and records it in the artifact header, along with schema_version, generated_at, and code_version. Console contract (v1): The summary JSON includes fields needed by Console to render a “Quality” card: `schema_version`, `experiment_id`, `eval_suite_id`, `control_variant_id`, `generated_at`, `min_samples`, plus an array of metric rows each containing `metric_key`, `variant_id`, `n`, `mean`, `delta_vs_control`, `ci_low`, `ci_high`, `p_value`, `p_value_adjusted`, `significant`, and `warnings` (string array flattened into a single semicolon-delimited string in this artifact). The details JSONL is keyed by `metric_key` and `variant_id` for table expansion and includes the same computed numbers plus `method` and `resamples`. Implementation notes: We intentionally keep the metric allowlist small for v1 (rubric_score, exact_match, win_rate, refusal_rate). Additional metrics should be added by extending `MetricRegistry` with explicit typing and missing-data semantics. Files are written using the existing `EvalArtifactStore` and follow the same partitioning conventions used by other reporters (experiment_id/eval_suite_id/run_id). Testing: Unit tests cover (a) delta correctness, (b) bootstrap CI bounds monotonicity, (c) missing score handling, and (d) multiple comparison adjustment behavior. Also included a golden-file snapshot for the summary artifact to prevent accidental schema drift. Rollout: This is behind a new reporter entrypoint `eval-harness report ab-experiment-quality` and is not invoked by default in existing pipelines. The Console integration can start consuming v1 artifacts as soon as the pipeline wiring lands on the Redwood side. Follow-ups: (1) Add optional online judge sampling results (deferred), (2) Add effect-size explanations text for Console, (3) Evaluate switching to BCa intervals if we see skewed distributions in common suites.
commits: b7c1f2a report: add AbExperimentQualityDeltaReporter skeleton + CLI entrypoint
3dd9a81 stats: bootstrap CI + p-values; add Holm–Bonferroni adjustment
1c0a4f5 artifacts: add v1 schema + golden snapshot tests
6f9b2d0 cleanup: metric registry allowlist + docs + type fixes
conversation: Jonas Weber (review): This is exactly what we need for the Console quality pane. Two asks: (1) can we ensure `control_variant_id` is explicit in the artifact (not inferred by name), and (2) please document how missing/invalid scores are handled per metric (e.g., refusal_rate denominator).

Olivia Grant (author): Added `control_variant_id` to the artifact header and updated docs with missing-data semantics per metric. For refusal_rate we compute over all prompts with a valid refusal label; we also record `n_total` and `n_valid` in details JSONL for transparency.

Sana Farid (review): Stats questions: bootstrap method is fine for v1, but we should (a) include the number of resamples and seed in the artifact, (b) avoid implying significance for very small N. Can we add an `insufficient_sample` warning gate that forces `significant=false` when N < min_samples?

Olivia Grant (author): Done. The reporter now records `resamples` + `seed` in header and in each metric row, and we set `significant=false` when `insufficient_sample=true` regardless of p-value. Also added tests for this behavior.

Mei Lin (review): Can we keep the artifact row shape stable for aggregation jobs? Suggest `metric_key` strings be normalized (snake_case) and keep `variant_id` as the canonical key (not display name).
Olivia Grant (author): Agreed. Updated to snake_case keys only; variant display names are intentionally omitted from the artifact and will be joined in Console.

Dylan Brooks (review): From the Console side: please ensure the top-level summary is a single JSON file and does not require reading the JSONL details. The summary should be enough to render the initial comparison table.
Olivia Grant (author): Summary now includes all computed fields needed for the table (mean, delta, CI, p-values, adjusted p-values, warnings). JSONL remains optional for future drilldowns.
CI bot: integration-smoke failed on first run (ImportError: `MetricRegistry` circular import).
Olivia Grant (author): Fixed by moving registry initialization behind a function and removing module-level imports in reporter. Reran CI.
Sana Farid (review): Approved after latest changes. Thanks for adding the insufficient-sample guardrail.
release_notes: Internal: New eval-harness reporter `ab-experiment-quality` exports versioned quality-delta summary artifacts for A/B experiments (Console consumption).
